lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: My friend,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I have a favor to ask of you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: It turns out that medal was a fake.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: One of my guests at a party happened to be a veteran.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: That petty old man was as fussy as you were.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: He kept giving me a hard time about it,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and before long, all my friends and family, as well as my fiancée,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: treated me like I was some liar.
So what do you want me to do about it?
What goes around comes around.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: You can laugh at me if you want,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: but as you know, I am a Sovereign.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I live and die by my reputation.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I rather die than live like this.
So how can I help?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: First, I will join you up on the surface.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Then, with the help of your Nikkes, we capture the biggest Rapture we can find,

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: and I record it all on video.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: That way, no one can call me a liar ever again.
Sounds risky.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I'm trained in self-defense, and I know my way around a firearm.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: I won't drag you down.
What about getting past the elevators?

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: That won't be a problem.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: If I tell them who my Father is, there isn't a door we can't open.

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: We'll meet tomorrow morning

lines.speaker: cervan
lines.text: at coordinates TTU 39.15.
